context: Implemented #32 and #42: registry auto-touch on every post/decide/record write (unknown skipped, historical agents never expunged), and dashboard single-instance guard (same-project probe across the retry window before binding; second instance stays MCP-only).
rationale: probing only the configured port would miss a first instance that was itself bumped by a foreign occupant; a different project's dashboard still falls through to the existing next-port retry.
summary: Chose a pre-bind same-project probe across the full port retry window (config.port..+5) for the #42 single-instance guard, reusing the existing /api/health projectRoot check
